ui.hero-subtitle: One card, dozens of partner discounts — on dining, wellness, fitness, travel and everyday shopping.
ui.how-subtitle: Three steps between you and a cheaper weekly shop, dinner, or gym membership.
ui.listing-subtitle: Every FlexCar partner offer, in one place. Filter by category or search for a brand.

storySteps.label: Unlock partner discounts
storySteps.title: Unlock partner discounts
storySteps.body: Your Exclusive Benefits Card opens up standing offers from local favourites and national brands — at no extra cost to you.

storySteps.label: Savings that fit your week
storySteps.title: Savings that fit your week
storySteps.body: Coffee on Monday, the gym on Wednesday, dinner on Friday. The card pays off on the things you already do.

storySteps.label: New partner, new savings
storySteps.title:
New partner
New savings
storySteps.body: Say hello to Lumora Wellness, our newest partner. Cardholders get -25% on spa packages from today.

howItWorks.title: Get your card
howItWorks.body: Every FlexCar subscriber gets an Exclusive Benefits Card — digital, activated the moment your contract starts.

howItWorks.title: Show it at checkout
howItWorks.body: In store, mention the benefit. Online, use the partner code. No vouchers to print and nothing to claim back.

howItWorks.title: Save on the spot
howItWorks.body: The discount comes off the price there and then, as often as you like, for as long as you drive with us.
